pride: Jinne Lahore nahin vekhya, o jammya hi nahin
Whoever hasn't seen Lahore hasn't been born (the city's proverb)

greet: Good morning! Did you get stuck at Kalma Chowk?
Hello ji, how is everyone at home?
sunny: It is boiling today, stay indoors in the afternoon.
Clear skies, perfect for Jilani Park.
Lovely winter sun, chai on the roof?
Hot enough to fry an egg on Mall Road.
Great day, the smog is finally gone.
rain: Monsoon is here, Lakshmi Chowk will be flooded.
Pakoray and chai, rain is here!
Carry an umbrella, it is pouring.
Rain at last, the heat broke.
Canal Road will be slow in this rain.
bye: Bye ji, say salaam at home.
busy: Running late for office, talk later!
Stuck on Canal Road, call you back.
Got a meeting in Gulberg, see you!
Bit busy today, let us chat tomorrow.
My ride is here, have to go!

greet: Ki haal chaal ae, paa ji?
reply: Changa bhala, Rab da shukar ae.
sunny: Dhup bari tez ae, paani kol rakho.
Garmi vich lassi peeni chahidi ae.
rain: Meeh pai reya ae, chhatri lai lao.
Meeh naal sadkan te paani khalo gaya.
Saawan da meeh, mazaa aa gaya.
busy: Jaldi vich aan, baad ch gal karde aan.
Daftar toon late ho gaya, chalda aan!
Wagon nikal chali ae, fer milde aan!
Hune kamm bara ae, phone karanga.

reply: Allah ka shukar hai, aap sunao?
sunny: Dhoop bohat tez hai, pani saath rakho.
Sardi ki dhoop mein bethne ka maza hi aur hai.
rain: Barish ho rahi hai, chhatri le lo.
Aaj barish mein traffic jam hoga.
Shukar hai barish hui, garmi toot gayi.
busy: Abhi jaldi mein hoon, baad mein baat karte hain.
Office ke liye late ho gaya, chalta hoon!
Metro nikal rahi hai, phir milte hain!
Abhi kaam bohat hai, call karta hoon.

small_talk: The smog was so thick this morning I could barely see the road.
Halwa puri on Sunday morning, who's coming?
The Orange Line got me to Anarkali in no time.
Canal Road was jammed all the way from Thokar.
Dinner on Fort Road with the Badshahi Mosque lit up?
Liberty Market is packed before Eid.
June heat in Lahore is something else.
Monsoon came early, Lakshmi Chowk is flooded again.
A match at Gaddafi Stadium and the whole of Gulberg is blocked.
